tfmg.inspector.vat.no_controller: This vat block lost track of the rest of its vat
tfmg.inspector.vat.no_controller.fix: Break and replace one block of the vat so it forms again.
tfmg.inspector.vat.no_machines: No machine attached: only recipes that need none can run
tfmg.inspector.vat.machine.unloaded: %s at %s is in an unloaded chunk
tfmg.inspector.vat.machine.down: %s at %s is attached but not working
tfmg.inspector.vat.machine.mixer.fix: The Industrial Mixer turns at %s RPM; give it at least %s RPM.
tfmg.inspector.vat.machine.compressor.fi: The Compressor turns at %s RPM; give it at least 120 RPM.
tfmg.inspector.vat.machine.freezer.fix: The Freezer draws %s A; it needs more than 3 A. Raise the voltage feeding it.
tfmg.inspector.vat.machine.electrode.fix: The Electrode Holder draws %s A; it needs at least %s A. Raise the voltage feeding its top face.
tfmg.inspector.vat.machine.no_power.fix: Its electrical network lacks power: add generators or remove consumers.
tfmg.inspector.vat.ignored.mixer_empty: Industrial Mixer at %s has no Mixer Blade or Centrifuge, so the vat ignores it
tfmg.inspector.vat.ignored.mixer_empty.f: Right-click the mixer with a Mixer Blade (mixing) or a Centrifuge (centrifuging).
tfmg.inspector.vat.ignored.mixer_positio: Industrial Mixer at %s is not over the centre of the vat, so the vat ignores it
On a 3 wide vat the mixer must sit on the centre block of the top, at %s.
tfmg.inspector.vat.ignored.electrode_emp: Electrode Holder at %s holds no electrode, so the vat ignores it
Right-click it with a Copper, Zinc or Graphite Electrode.
tfmg.inspector.vat.empty.fix: Pipe fluids or insert items into the vat; JEI lists every vat recipe with what it needs.
tfmg.inspector.vat.outputs_full: The output has no room for the result
tfmg.inspector.vat.outputs_full.fix: Empty the vat's output: pull items out with a funnel or chute and pump the output fluids away.
tfmg.inspector.vat.no_recipe_for_inputs: No vat recipe uses what is inside
Check the ingredients in JEI and empty out what does not belong to the recipe you want.
tfmg.inspector.vat.no_recipe: No recipe can run with this setup
tfmg.inspector.vat.too_small: The vat is too small: %s blocks, the recipe needs %s
tfmg.inspector.vat.too_small.fix: Build the vat to at least %s blocks in total (width x width x height).
tfmg.inspector.vat.wrong_type: This recipe does not run in a %s
tfmg.inspector.vat.wrong_type.fix: Rebuild the vat out of one of: %s.
tfmg.inspector.vat.machines_down: An attached machine is not working, which blocks every recipe
tfmg.inspector.vat.machines_down.fix: Fix the machine marked as not working in the list above.
tfmg.inspector.vat.heat_low: Not hot enough: heat level %s, the recipe needs %s
tfmg.inspector.vat.heat_low.fix: Add %s more heat level under the vat: a lit Blaze Burner gives 1, a superheated one 2. Each working Freezer on the vat removes 1.
tfmg.inspector.vat.pressure_low: Pressure too low: %s, the recipe needs %s
tfmg.inspector.vat.pressure_low.fix: Add %s more Compressor(s) above or below the vat, turning forward at 120 RPM or more.
tfmg.inspector.vat.pressure_high: Pressure too high: %s, the recipe needs %s or less
tfmg.inspector.vat.pressure_high.fix: Add %s more Compressor(s) turning in reverse at 120 RPM or more, or remove forward ones.
tfmg.inspector.vat.missing_fluid: Missing fluid: %s mB of %s (best tank holds %s mB)
tfmg.inspector.vat.missing_ingredient.fi: Add the missing ingredients to the vat's input; each fluid needs its own tank segment.
tfmg.inspector.vat.op_fix.tfmg.mixing: Place an Industrial Mixer on top of the vat (on the centre block if it is 3 wide), right-click it with a Mixer Blade and turn it at medium speed or more.
tfmg.inspector.vat.op_fix.tfmg.centrifug: Place an Industrial Mixer on top of the vat (on the centre block if it is 3 wide), right-click it with a Centrifuge and turn it at medium speed or more.
tfmg.inspector.vat.op_fix.tfmg.pressuris: Place a Compressor directly above or below the vat and turn it forward at 120 RPM or more.
tfmg.inspector.vat.op_fix.tfmg.depressur: Place a Compressor directly above or below the vat and turn it in reverse at 120 RPM or more.
tfmg.inspector.vat.op_fix.tfmg.freezing: Place a Freezer directly above or below the vat and power it with more than 3 A.
tfmg.inspector.vat.op_fix.tfmg.electrode: Place an Electrode Holder on top of the vat, right-click it with a Copper or Zinc Electrode and power it from its top face.
tfmg.inspector.vat.op_fix.tfmg.graphite_: Place an Electrode Holder on top of the vat, right-click it with a Graphite Electrode and power it from its top face.
tfmg.inspector.mixer.no_tool: No Mixer Blade or Centrifuge installed
tfmg.inspector.mixer.no_tool.fix: Right-click the mixer with a Mixer Blade (mixing recipes) or a Centrifuge (centrifuge recipes).
tfmg.inspector.mixer.too_slow: Too slow: %s RPM, the mixer needs %s RPM
tfmg.inspector.mixer.too_slow.fix: Speed up the shaft driving it to at least %2$s RPM (a speed controller or a gear-up).
tfmg.inspector.mixer.no_vat: No chemical vat under the mixer
tfmg.inspector.mixer.no_vat.fix: Place the Industrial Mixer directly on top of a chemical vat.
tfmg.inspector.mixer.off_center: The mixer is not over the centre of the vat
tfmg.inspector.mixer.off_center.fix: On a 3 wide vat, move the mixer onto the centre block of the vat's top layer.
tfmg.inspector.compressor.pressurizing: Turning forward: raises the vat pressure
tfmg.inspector.compressor.depressurizing: Turning in reverse: lowers the vat pressure
tfmg.inspector.compressor.too_slow: Too slow: %s RPM, the compressor needs %s RPM
tfmg.inspector.compressor.too_slow.fix: Speed up the shaft driving it to at least %2$s RPM.
tfmg.inspector.compressor.no_vat: No chemical vat directly above or below
tfmg.inspector.compressor.no_vat.fix: Place the Compressor directly under or on top of a chemical vat.
tfmg.inspector.freezer.current_ok: Enough current: %s A (needs more than %s A)
tfmg.inspector.freezer.low_current: Not enough current: %s A, the freezer needs more than %s A
tfmg.inspector.freezer.low_current.fix: Raise the voltage of its network: at 75 ohms it needs more than 225 V.
tfmg.inspector.freezer.no_vat: No chemical vat directly above or below
tfmg.inspector.freezer.no_vat.fix: Place the Freezer directly under or on top of a chemical vat.
tfmg.inspector.electrode.none.fix: Right-click the holder with a Copper or Zinc Electrode (electrolysis) or a Graphite Electrode (arc furnace).
tfmg.inspector.electrode.faces: Takes power from its top face only
tfmg.inspector.electrode.low_current: Not enough current: %s A, the electrode needs %s A
tfmg.inspector.electrode.low_current.fix: Raise the voltage feeding its top face, or use an electrode with lower resistance.
tfmg.inspector.electrode.no_vat: No chemical vat under the holder
tfmg.inspector.electrode.no_vat.fix: Place the Electrode Holder directly on top of a chemical vat.
tfmg.inspector.generator.speed_ok: Fast enough: %s RPM, generation starts above %s RPM
tfmg.inspector.generator.too_slow: Too slow: %s RPM, nothing is generated below %s RPM
tfmg.inspector.generator.too_slow.fix: Turn it faster than %2$s RPM; output grows with every RPM above that.
tfmg.inspector.generator.max_at: Reaches its %s V maximum at %s RPM
tfmg.inspector.rotor.stators_missing: Stator ring incomplete: %s of %s stators, nothing is generated
tfmg.inspector.rotor.stators_missing.fix: Place a Stator on every block of the ring around the rotor (the 8 blocks around it, across its axis).
tfmg.inspector.rotor.stator_taken: The stator at %s belongs to another rotor
tfmg.inspector.rotor.faces: Power comes out of the rotor's side faces, not its shaft ends
tfmg.inspector.stator.no_rotor: This stator is not part of a large generator
tfmg.inspector.stator.no_rotor.fix: Place a Rotor so this stator is one of the 8 blocks of the ring around it.
tfmg.inspector.motor.faces: Takes power from its %s face (the back)
tfmg.inspector.motor.faces_lying: Takes power from its %s face (the back) and its bottom face
tfmg.inspector.motor.not_connected: Nothing electrical is connected to a face that powers the motor
tfmg.inspector.motor.not_connected.fix: Connect a cable or a powered block to its %s face.
tfmg.inspector.motor.not_connected.fix_l: Connect a cable or a powered block to its %s face or under it.
tfmg.inspector.motor.speed_from_voltage: %s V gives %s RPM (0.8 RPM per volt)
tfmg.inspector.motor.undersupplied: Network short of power: %s W supplied, %s W used. The motor stops
tfmg.inspector.accumulator.member: Part of the accumulator bank controlled at %s:

tfmg.inspector.accumulator.chain: Bank of %s, outputs %s V on its %s and %s ends
tfmg.inspector.accumulator.no_spare_powe: Not charging: the network has no spare power
tfmg.inspector.accumulator.redstone: A redstone signal (%s) blocks the output
tfmg.inspector.accumulator.redstone.fix: Remove the redstone signal from the bank to let it discharge.
tfmg.inspector.accumulator.idle: Idle: nothing on the network draws power
tfmg.inspector.accumulator.charge.fix: To charge it, feed its ends with more than %s V (%s V per accumulator in the bank).
tfmg.inspector.converter.mode_input: Mode TFMG to FE: TFMG cable on the %s face, FE machines on any other face
tfmg.inspector.converter.mode_output: Mode FE to TFMG: TFMG cable on the %s face, outputs %s V
tfmg.inspector.converter.voltage_low: Not charging: %s V on the TFMG side, it needs at least %s V
tfmg.inspector.converter.voltage_low.fix: Feed its TFMG face with at least %s V.
tfmg.inspector.converter.dial_high: Not charging: the network gives %s V but the dial is set to %s V
tfmg.inspector.converter.dial_high.fix: Scroll the converter's value down to %s V or less.
tfmg.inspector.converter.no_spare_power: Not charging: the network has no spare power
tfmg.inspector.converter.no_fe: No Forge Energy stored, nothing to convert
tfmg.inspector.converter.no_fe.fix: Push FE into it from any face but the TFMG one.
tfmg.inspector.converter.no_load: Ready: nothing on the network draws power
tfmg.inspector.converter.mode.fix: Use a Wrench on it to switch between the two modes.
tfmg.inspector.bridge.faces: Input on the %s face, output on the %s face
tfmg.inspector.bridge.no_output: Nothing takes power on the output (%s) face
tfmg.inspector.bridge.no_output.fix: Connect a cable or a machine to its %s face.
tfmg.inspector.bridge.output_voltage: Passes %s V to the output side
tfmg.inspector.switch.open: Open: no redstone signal, nothing passes
tfmg.inspector.switch.open.fix: Power it with redstone; the output voltage scales with the signal (15 = full voltage).
tfmg.inspector.switch.closed: Closed: signal %s, passes %s%% of the voltage
Right-click the side of the transformer with an Electromagnetic Coil (wound on the Winding Machine).
tfmg.inspector.transformer.coil_few_turn: The %s has only %s turns, it needs %s
Wind the coil on the Winding Machine until it has 50 turns or more.
tfmg.inspector.large_transformer.output_: Output half of the large transformer:
tfmg.inspector.large_transformer.no_main: The other half of this transformer is missing
Rebuild it: two Large Coils side by side, then right-click one with a Laminated Magnetic Alloy Block.
tfmg.inspector.large_transformer.faces: Input on top of this block, output on top of the other half
tfmg.inspector.large_transformer.no_rati: Rebuild it from two Large Coils that both have turns.
tfmg.inspector.large_transformer.needs_s: Right-click it with a Steel Block to carry up to 50000 W.
tfmg.inspector.large_transformer.needs_o: Right-click it with a Lubrication Oil Bucket to carry up to 100000 W.
tfmg.inspector.large_coil.no_turns.fix: Use a Large Coil wound with turns; an empty one gives no ratio.
tfmg.inspector.large_coil.pair: Next to a coil of %s turns: ratio %s if this one is the input
tfmg.inspector.large_coil.no_pair: No other Large Coil next to it
tfmg.inspector.large_coil.no_pair.fix: Place a second Large Coil beside it, on the same level.
tfmg.inspector.large_coil.assemble.fix: Right-click the input coil with a Laminated Magnetic Alloy Block to build the transformer; the ratio is output turns divided by input turns.
tfmg.inspector.large_switch.output_part: Output half of the large switch:
tfmg.inspector.large_switch.no_main: The other half of this switch is missing
tfmg.inspector.large_switch.open.fix_rev: Its rotation opens it: reverse the rotation to close it.
tfmg.inspector.large_switch.open.fix: Turn its shaft: one direction closes the arm, the other opens it.
tfmg.inspector.large_switch.faces: Input on the back of this block, output on the front of the other half
tfmg.inspector.polarizer.face: Takes power from its %s face (the back)
tfmg.inspector.polarizer.empty.fix: Insert an item that has a polarizing recipe (see JEI).
tfmg.inspector.polarizer.no_recipe.fix: Take it out and insert an item with a polarizing recipe (see JEI).
tfmg.inspector.polarizer.power_low: Not enough power: %s W, it needs %s W to charge
tfmg.inspector.polarizer.power_low.fix: Raise the voltage on its back face to about 245 V or more (2000 W at 30 ohms).
tfmg.inspector.pump.electric: Runs on electricity: it does not need rotation
tfmg.inspector.pump.no_power: It draws no power, so it does not pump
tfmg.inspector.pump.full_at: Full pressure at %s V, full range at %s V
tfmg.inspector.light.face: Takes power from its %s face (the back)
tfmg.inspector.light.over_limit: %s V is over its %s V limit: it will burn out
tfmg.inspector.light.over_limit.fix: Lower the voltage with a Transformer or a Resistor before the light.
tfmg.inspector.light.redstone_off: Switched off by a redstone signal
tfmg.inspector.light.redstone_off.fix: Remove the redstone signal to turn it on.
tfmg.inspector.connector.no_wires.fix: Right-click it with a cable, then right-click another Cable Insulator.
tfmg.inspector.connector.attached: Connected to the block on its %s face
tfmg.inspector.connector.not_attached: No electrical block on its %s face (the one it is mounted on)
tfmg.inspector.hub.current: Network current %s A, hub rated %s A
tfmg.inspector.hub.near: Network current %s A is close to the hub's %s A limit
tfmg.inspector.hub.over: Network current %s A is over the hub's %s A limit: it will break
tfmg.inspector.hub.over.fix: Use a higher rated cable hub or split the load across separate networks.
tfmg.inspector.engine.no_master: This engine block lost the rest of its engine
tfmg.inspector.engine.no_master.fix: Break and replace one block of the engine so it connects again.
Right-click the engine with a %s; every block of the engine needs its own set of parts.
Right-click the block with %s, all made for the same fuel, until every slot is filled.
tfmg.inspector.engine.no_fuel.fix_unknow: Pump in the fuel its cylinders were made for (the cylinder tooltip names it).
tfmg.inspector.engine.no_fuel_list: %s does not name any fuel, so no fuel is accepted
tfmg.inspector.engine.no_fuel_list.fix: Use cylinders crafted for a fuel (JEI shows one per fuel), then reinsert them.
tfmg.inspector.engine.wrong_fuel: Wrong fuel: %s is not burned by %s
tfmg.inspector.engine.wrong_fuel.fix: Drain the tank and pump in one of: %s. Or swap the cylinders for ones made for this fuel.
tfmg.inspector.engine.exhaust_full: Exhaust tank full: the engine stalls
tfmg.inspector.engine.exhaust_full.fix: Pump the carbon dioxide out of the engine, into a smokestack or a tank.
tfmg.inspector.engine.controlled_by: Driven by the Engine Controller at %s
tfmg.inspector.engine.controller_missing: Linked Engine Controller at %s is gone
Pull the Transmission off with a Wrench and link it to a controller again.
tfmg.inspector.engine.controller_stopped: The engine is switched off at its controller
Sit at the Engine Controller and press the Start Engine key (default I).
tfmg.inspector.engine.no_throttle.fix: Hold the accelerator key while seated at the controller.
tfmg.inspector.engine.neutral.fix: Shift up with the Transmission Shift Up key (default V).
tfmg.inspector.engine.no_signal: No redstone signal: the engine stays at 0 RPM
tfmg.inspector.engine.no_signal.fix: Power any block of the engine with redstone; speed and torque grow with the signal (15 = full).
tfmg.inspector.engine.no_shaft: No output shaft: the engine delivers nothing
tfmg.inspector.engine.no_shaft.fix: Right-click an end block of the engine (one with nothing in front of it) with a Shaft.
tfmg.inspector.engine.lubrication: Lubrication oil %s mB, cooling fluid %s mB
tfmg.inspector.engine.lubrication.fix: Optional: an Oil Can or Lubrication Oil Bucket and a Cooling Fluid Bottle or bucket each cut fuel use by 30%%.
tfmg.inspector.large_engine.drives_shaft: Drives the shaft 2 blocks in front of it; the engine block itself does not turn
tfmg.inspector.large_engine.shaft_unload: The shaft position %s is in an unloaded chunk
tfmg.inspector.large_engine.shaft_axis: The shaft at %s points into the engine
tfmg.inspector.large_engine.shaft_axis.f: Turn the shaft so it runs across the engine, not toward it.
tfmg.inspector.large_engine.no_shaft.fix: Place a Shaft at %s running across the engine, then break and replace the engine so it grabs it.
tfmg.inspector.large_engine.no_air: No air: the engine cannot burn its fuel
tfmg.inspector.large_engine.no_air.fix: Pump air in from Air Intakes; it burns 150 mB per cycle.
tfmg.inspector.controller.no_engine.fix: Right-click the controller with a Transmission, then right-click the engine with that Transmission to install it.
tfmg.inspector.controller.engine_unloade: The linked engine at %s is in an unloaded chunk
tfmg.inspector.controller.engine_missing: The linked engine at %s is gone
tfmg.inspector.controller.link_lost: The engine no longer answers to this controller
